name: Party Identification 76
definition: Set of elements used to identify a person or an organisation.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifies the owner of the investment account which is used to acquire or sell financial instruments.

CountryOfBranch.name: Country Of Branch
CountryOfBranch.definition: Country of the branch that received the order from the client or made an investment decision for a client in accordance with a discretionary mandate given to it by the client.
